text: probes_final reports the control R2 only at each run's best-margin layer, and that layer differs between arms (for example N=128 m2-fixed layer 4 vs N=256 layers 1/3). Can the pipeline export per-layer control R2 for every target, so cross-N control comparisons can be made at a fixed layer rather than at whichever layer each run's best margin happens to land on?
